This surge in investment is anticipated to enhance the US economy, potentially adding about 0.75 percentage points to GDP growth. Still, firms are grappling with mounting cash flow pressures and declining bond demand.

candidates.title: Rupee gains 29 paise against dollar in early trade, but crude prices limit gains
candidates.excerpt: On Wednesday, the Rupee saw an impressive rise of nearly 0.5% against the US Dollar, marking its highest point in six weeks. This boost was fueled by strong foreign currency inflows from the Jio IPO and positive movements in the equity markets. Nonetheless, high crude oil prices presented challenges for the domestic currency, with the dollar index inching up and Brent crude futures rising notably.

candidates.title: More trouble for CJP leaders: Another FIR against Das, Ranka transferred to Crime Branch
candidates.excerpt: Delhi Police has transferred two FIRs against Cockroach Janta Party leaders to the Crime Branch for investigation. The leaders, Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka, were detained during protests at Connaught Place and Jantar Mantar. Legal challenges have been filed by their team to contest an extension of their judicial custody. They claim their continued detention violates their fundamental rights and due process.

candidates.title: Sensex Jumps 823 Points, Nifty Gains Nearly 1% on IT Stocks, Reliance Buying
candidates.excerpt: Markets rebound from previous session’s sharp losses as positive global cues and strong buying in IT stocks lift investor sentiment; Jio Platforms IPO sees 85% subscription within minutes.

candidates.title: Can a magistrate summon you for extortion without evidence? Patna HC answers
candidates.excerpt: Recently, the Patna high court dismissed a criminal case citing insufficient evidence to support the extortion claims. The court highlighted that the allegations did not fulfill the legal criteria set by the Indian Penal Code. Moreover, the accused was absent during the incidents detailed in the complaint, pointing out misuse of the legal system for personal vendettas. This ruling emphasized the importance of adhering to due process in criminal matters.

candidates.title: In talks with Reliance to refine more Venezuelan oil: US secretary of state Marco Rubio
candidates.excerpt: US secretary of state Marco Rubio is visiting Jamnagar Wednesday to tour the Reliance refinery and, in a lastminute change of schedule, is likely to spend the night there. He was earlier scheduled to leave around 9pm and return to Mumbai. In Jamnagar, he will have dinner with Mukesh Ambani at the Vantara centre. Rubio’s visit to Jamnagar comes within weeks of a vicious attack on Ambani by Elon Musk.

candidates.excerpt: Higher Education Minister had announced in Assembly that the honorarium for guest lecturers would be hiked by ₹5,000 to ₹35,000

candidates.title: AAIB chief gets a year's extension as many key probes, including AI 171, on
candidates.excerpt: People in the know say while the aviation ministry “keeps the aircraft accident investigating agency at an arm’s length and does not interfere in its working in any way,” it is taking steps to strengthen the AAIB. The bureau's lab has been recently upgraded and it now has the capability to download cockpit voice recorder and digital flight data recorder (black box) to know the conversation in the flight deck and the flight parameters till before an event being investigated.

candidates.title: Murder FIR on 10-yr-old girl for pushing toddler from sixth floor in Mumbai
candidates.excerpt: An 18-month-old toddler fell to her death from a sixth-floor stairwell in Goregaon. Police registered a murder FIR against her 10-year-old neighbor based on the mother's complaint. The child's mother stated that the older girl had gestured for her daughter to approach her. After the incident, the 10-year-old was placed in counseling through an NGO. Experts emphasize the importance of rehabilitation for the young girl rather than punitive measures.

candidates.title: Influencer with 1.3 million followers dies by suicide in Chennai
candidates.excerpt: V Harish, a 27-year-old social media influencer, was found dead in Chennai after alleged cyberbullying. His father accused another influencer, Jason Samuel, of causing severe mental distress through defamatory posts. Harish's online channels were reported and blocked multiple times, contributing to his emotional turmoil. Before his death, he recorded a video blaming Samuel for his situation. Police have registered a case and are investigating the claims made by both parties.
